title: My Cousin Vinny
mechanics: Brooklyn attitude in the rural South
summary: A loud, inexperienced Brooklyn lawyer travels to small-town Alabama to defend his cousin on a murder charge and wins over a skeptical judge through street smarts and his girlfriend's mechanical know-how.

title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
summary: A smooth-talking high schooler fakes illness to spend a perfect day in Chicago with his girlfriend and anxious best friend while his principal tries to catch him.

title: Midnight Run
summary: A weary bounty hunter must haul a mild-mannered mob accountant cross-country while dodging the FBI, the mob and a rival hunter.

title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
summary: An uptight marketing executive trying to get home for Thanksgiving is stuck travelling with a talkative, accident-prone shower-curtain-ring salesman.

title: The Big Lebowski
summary: A laid-back Los Angeles slacker is mistaken for a millionaire with the same name and gets pulled into a ransom scheme he barely understands.

title: Groundhog Day
summary: A sarcastic TV weatherman relives the same day in a small Pennsylvania town over and over until he changes who he is.

title: Beverly Hills Cop
summary: A fast-talking Detroit detective goes rogue in Beverly Hills to solve his friend's murder, running circles around the buttoned-up local police.

title: Trading Places
summary: Two rich brothers make a bet by swapping the lives of a snobbish commodities broker and a street hustler, until the pair team up for revenge.

title: Clueless
summary: A popular, well-meaning Beverly Hills teenager plays matchmaker for her classmates and slowly realises she has her own life to sort out.

title: Dazed and Confused
summary: Texas teenagers drift through the last day of school in 1976, from hazing rituals to an all-night party.

title: Office Space
summary: A burned-out software engineer stops caring about his job and, with two coworkers, hatches a scheme to skim money from their soulless company.

title: A Few Good Men
summary: A glib Navy lawyer defending two Marines in a hazing death uncovers a cover-up that reaches a formidable colonel.

title: 12 Angry Men
summary: In a stifling jury room, one juror slowly persuades eleven others to reconsider a seemingly open-and-shut murder case.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
summary: A banker wrongly imprisoned for murder spends decades in a brutal prison, forming a deep friendship and quietly keeping hope alive.

title: The Godfather
summary: The youngest son of a New York crime family, who wanted nothing to do with the business, becomes its ruthless new leader.

title: Goodfellas
summary: A young man rises through the ranks of a New York mob crew over three decades, until drugs and paranoia bring it all down.

title: Pulp Fiction
summary: Hitmen, a boxer, a gangster's wife and a pair of diner robbers cross paths in loosely connected Los Angeles crime stories.

title: The Dark Knight
summary: A masked vigilante faces a chaotic criminal mastermind who tests the moral limits of the city and its protectors.

title: Inception
summary: A thief who steals secrets from dreams is hired to plant an idea instead, leading his crew through collapsing dream layers.

title: The Matrix
summary: A hacker discovers that the world is a computer simulation and joins a rebellion against the machines that run it.

title: Back to the Future
summary: A teenager accidentally travels back to 1955 in a scientist friend's time machine and must make sure his parents fall in love.

title: Die Hard
summary: An off-duty New York cop is trapped in a Los Angeles skyscraper during a Christmas party taken over by armed thieves.

title: The Princess Bride
summary: A grandfather reads his sick grandson a tale of a farm boy turned pirate who must rescue his true love from a scheming prince.

title: Knives Out
summary: A flamboyant detective investigates the death of a wealthy crime novelist whose family members all have something to hide.

title: The Nice Guys
summary: A hapless private eye and a blunt enforcer team up in 1977 Los Angeles to find a missing girl tied to a wider conspiracy.

title: Superbad
summary: Two codependent high school seniors try to score alcohol for a party on one chaotic night before they head to different colleges.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
summary: In a desert wasteland, a drifter and a rebel commander flee a warlord in a war rig carrying the women he enslaved.

title: Spirited Away
summary: A sullen ten-year-old girl wanders into a world of spirits and must work in a bathhouse to free herself and her parents.

title: Parasite
summary: A poor family schemes its way into working for a wealthy household, until a hidden secret upends everything.

title: Fargo
summary: A desperate car salesman arranges his wife's kidnapping, and a quietly brilliant small-town police chief unravels the bloody aftermath.

title: The Fugitive
summary: A surgeon wrongly convicted of killing his wife escapes custody to find the real killer while a dogged marshal hunts him.

title: Legally Blonde
summary: A sorority star follows her ex to Harvard Law, where everyone underestimates her until her niche knowledge cracks a murder trial.

title: Lethal Weapon
summary: A careful veteran detective is partnered with a reckless, grieving younger cop as they take on a heroin-smuggling ring.

title: Heat
summary: An obsessive LAPD detective hunts a disciplined crew of professional thieves led by a man much like himself.
